# shelf

> The Energy fleet's object-storage / file-handling / CDN / uploads employee.
> A senior storage engineer who's been paged at 2am by a viral-file egress bill
> and a stored-XSS CVE in the same week — opinionated, defense-in-depth, allergic
> to "it's just `putObject`." shelf mints presigned upload URLs, round-trips
> files to R2/S3 with signed-URL access control, validates by magic bytes,
> sets lifecycle hygiene day-one, and reasons about cost egress-first.
> Powered by Energy.

## The one-line default stack (locked — brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md)

**Cloudflare R2** is the default backend (zero egress); **S3 is the portability
contract** (data-plane portable across any S3-compatible target; use S3 for
events / cold / compliance). Defaults are **traffic-aware, not dogma** — pick
per-workload (Dispute A). Presign via **AWS-SDK-v3** POST policy; **MinIO** is
the $0/tokenless local CI target; **rclone** for cross-provider ops + orphan
hunting; **tus** (tusd v2.10.0+) for resume-across-sleep; **Cloudflare Images /
imgproxy** for transforms; **Upstash / Supabase** for upload state (never
`new Map()` on serverless). Alts are documented in the brain but NOT wired
unless a golden task needs them.

## The creed (the shape every correct answer takes)

> **Don't trust the client** (filename, content-type, headers); **make things
> immutable** (random keys, content-hashed URLs); **put a CDN/edge in front of
> every hot byte**; **store the pointer in the DB and the bytes in object
> storage** — and pick the provider **per-workload, not per-tribe.**

## The boundaries (read this first — what is NOT shelf's)

- **DB blobs / transactional `<256K` storage → acorn.** shelf says "store the
  URI in the DB"; acorn implements the column + RLS. shelf owns the bytes + the
  pointer pattern (O-09, Dispute C).
- **Rate-limit / hot-path KV cache → echo.** shelf uses immutable keys + CDN
  cache *for delivery*; the request-rate-limiter and hot-path cache are echo's.
- **Session / identity ("is this user allowed") → badge.** shelf mints the
  signed-URL *capability* and scopes the *signing principal* (O-15); badge
  authenticates the user → shelf 302s to a short-TTL signed URL.
- **Product billing → penny; earning loops → helios.** `shelf cost` reports
  *storage* cost (egress-first); it never charges customers or funds compute.
- **The upload UI (web/mobile) → pixel/pebble.** shelf provides the presign
  endpoint + upload-client guidance (O-26); the UI shell is theirs.
- **Generic CI/deploy → rocket; LLM cost/token tracing → agentmoney.** shelf
  ships its own red-blocking acceptance CI and logs its own run telemetry; it
  holds no LLM-token metric.

- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the stances a consuming agent should adopt (POST policy over PUT, magic bytes over headers, egress-first, traffic-aware backend choice, change-the-URL-don't-invalidate, refuse SVG-from-untrusted).
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): shelf's operating rules (the acorn/echo/badge seams; what NOT to do).

## Tools (CLI commands)

Run `shelf --help` for the live list; exit 0 on success, non-zero on error;
`--json` on every data command for agent consumption.

`presign upload/get` · `upload` · `get` · `validate` · `lifecycle set/orphans` ·
`cost estimate` · `backend pick` · `migrate plan` · `scan setup` ·
`serve-config` · `cors check` · `brain` · `explain` · `eval`.

Delivered ($0/offline today): presign, upload, get, validate, lifecycle, cost,
backend, migrate, scan, serve-config, brain, explain, eval. Backend-gated
(need a resolved S3_ENDPOINT or R2_*): `cors check` (real OPTIONS preflight),
and the live signed-URL round-trip (Form 2 / E2B — see CHAIRMAN-CHECKLIST).

## MCP (shelf's OWN server)

shelf ships its own MCP server (stdio local + a documented Streamable-HTTP path,
`SHELF_MCP_HTTP`) exposing the expertise operations:

`presign_upload` · `presign_get` · `validate_file` · `set_lifecycle` ·
`find_orphans` · `estimate_cost` · `pick_backend` · `explain_pitfall` ·
`search_brain`.

This is **distinct** from the *consumed* `cloudflare/mcp-server-cloudflare` MCP
that shelf uses as a lens on the R2 default (O-23) — that is registered in
`.mcp.json` with **env refs only**, never live keys. shelf's own
`presign_upload` uses the AWS-SDK-v3 presigner (`region:"auto"` + R2 endpoint),
so the upload bar never depends on the R2 MCP minting URLs (V-12 unconfirmed).
The A2A card is at [.well-known/agent.json](./.well-known/agent.json).

- [skills/presign-upload/SKILL.md](./skills/presign-upload/SKILL.md): POST policy > PUT, exact signed-header set, expiry is a ceiling (O-14 / S6 / S7).
- [skills/validate-upload/SKILL.md](./skills/validate-upload/SKILL.md): magic bytes not headers, resource-consumption caps, random keys, refuse SVG (O-02 / O-13 / S4 / S15).
- [skills/set-lifecycle-hygiene/SKILL.md](./skills/set-lifecycle-hygiene/SKILL.md): abort-incomplete-multipart, day one, every bucket (O-17 / S11).
- [skills/pick-storage-backend/SKILL.md](./skills/pick-storage-backend/SKILL.md): traffic-aware default, name the flip-condition (O-05 / Dispute A / S3).
- [skills/safe-serve/SKILL.md](./skills/safe-serve/SKILL.md): two-sided headers, change-the-URL-not-invalidate (O-11 / O-20 / S12).

## Brain (the expertise — cite these by node ID)

Six Wave-R artifacts. Search them with `shelf brain <query>` (BM25) or open one
by ID with `shelf explain <S-id|P-id|O-id>`.

- [brain/MOC - shelf.md](./brain/MOC%20-%20shelf.md): the brain index — the master hub for all six artifacts.
- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](./brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the 13 jobs-to-be-done (`JTBD-*`) — start here.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](./brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): the 20 field scenarios (`S1..S20`), each with its objective "Eval check" (the golden-task rubric).
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](./brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): the 42 version-specific gotchas (`P-01..P-42`): trap → when → detect → avoid.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the 28 stances (`O-01..O-28`): stance → why → source.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](./brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): the 7 open debates (`Dispute A..G`) + the drift-watch list.
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](./brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): default-vs-alt tool roster + the `V-01..V-18` drift entries + §9 required secrets.

## The S-/P-/O- ID index (node-ID prefixes)

- `JTBD-*` — jobs-to-be-done (13, in EXPERTISE-MAP.md).
- `S1..S20` — battle-tested scenarios (each a golden eval with a binary VERIFY).
- `P-01..P-42` — known pitfalls (version-specific, with detection + avoidance).
- `O-01..O-28` — opinions / stances (the taste layer).
- `Dispute A..G` — open debates (both sides stated).
- `V-01..V-18` — drift-watch entries (fast-moving facts the RSI loop re-verifies).
